summary: Sheriff's deputies booked a man on robbery and drug charges Thursday, and Silverhill police arrested a woman on an elder-abuse charge. The jail roster shows 21 criminal bookings dated Oct. 29; Michael Ace Salter, booked Oct. 28 on drug-trafficking and firearm charges, was released Oct. 29.

entries.title: Robbery arrest: Charvez Lavon Gonzales
body: Charvez Lavon Gonzales, 26, was arrested by sheriff's deputies Thursday, Oct. 29, according to the jail roster, which gives no arrest time.

He was booked on charges of robbery listed as "street, other weapon" — taking property by force or threat outside a home or business, with a weapon other than a gun or knife — and possession of dangerous drugs. He was in custody when the roster was read Friday morning. The sheriff's office has not posted details of the arrest.

entries.title: Elder abuse arrest: Zoe Ocean Nolau
body: Zoe Ocean Nolau, 27, was arrested by Silverhill police at 5:53 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 29, according to the jail roster.

She was booked on a charge of second-degree elder abuse and neglect — abuse or neglect of an elderly person causing injury. She was in custody when the roster was read Friday morning. Police have not released further details.

entries.title: Firearm theft arrest: Brandon Matthew Donovan
body: Brandon Matthew Donovan, 37, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 3 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 29, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on a charge of theft of a firearm. The roster shows him released the same day.

entries.title: Drug possession arrests: six booked Oct. 29
body: Sheriff's deputies booked four people Thursday, Oct. 29, on drug-possession charges, according to the jail roster: Holly Kate Collins, 49 (two counts of possession of dangerous drugs); Amber Lee Meredith, 40 (possession of dangerous drugs, illegal possession of prescription drugs and drug paraphernalia); Eric Steven Broadus, 49 (possession of dangerous drugs and drug paraphernalia); and Timothy Bryan Heaton, 55 (possession of dangerous drugs). All four were in custody when the roster was read.

Orange Beach police arrested Sean Michael Tedder, 40, and Armista Michelle Saldana, 38, at 7:53 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28; both were booked Oct. 29. Tedder was booked on marijuana and paraphernalia charges and released Oct. 29; Saldana on possession of dangerous drugs and released Oct. 30.
"Possession of dangerous drugs" is the jail's term for possessing a controlled substance; the roster does not name the drug.

entries.title: Drug-trafficking and firearm arrest: Michael Ace Salter
body: Michael Ace Salter, 22, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 3 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, and booked into the county jail Wednesday, Oct. 28, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on charges of drug trafficking, two counts of sale or distribution of dangerous drugs, being a drunk or drug addict in possession of a firearm — a person barred from having a gun by drug or alcohol use — and tampering with physical evidence, meaning destroying or hiding evidence. The roster shows him released Thursday, Oct. 29; it does not say on what terms.

The roster also shows a booking for Michael Ace Salter, 22, on Oct. 22 by sheriff's deputies, on charges of synthetic narcotic possession and being a drunk or drug addict in possession of a firearm; that record shows a release.

entries.title: Stolen-property and drug arrest: Bryan Lardor Soles
body: Bryan Lardor Soles, 31, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 12:15 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on charges of buying or receiving stolen property — taking property knowing it was stolen — possession of dangerous drugs and first-offense drug paraphernalia. He was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: School threat arrest: Foley High School student
body: Foley police said a Foley High School student was arrested Thursday, Oct. 29, after a report of a weapon on campus. Police searched several areas in and around the school and did not find a firearm, according to the department's account reported by FOX10 and NBC 15.
Police did not name the student or state the charge. Police said the case is being referred to the Juvenile Court of Baldwin County.

entries.title: Family-violence arrests: Joshua Kyle Marques Hall, Skylar Devon Jemison
body: Sheriff's deputies made two arrests on family-violence charges Tuesday evening, Oct. 27, according to the jail roster; both were booked Wednesday, Oct. 28.

Joshua Kyle Marques Hall, 28, was arrested at 7:54 p.m. and booked on a charge of simple assault against a family or household member. Skylar Devon Jemison, 20, was arrested at 10:45 p.m. and booked on a charge of harassment of a family or household member. Both were in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Assault arrest: Erik Stephen Smith
body: Erik Stephen Smith, 52, was arrested by sheriff's deputies Wednesday, Oct. 28, according to the jail roster, which gives no arrest time.
He was booked on a charge of third-degree assault — causing physical injury to another person. He was in custody when the roster was read.
